nodes.label: Visual Design Conventions
nodes.rationale: Dark-first, cinematic, refined-purple identity. No design-token system. Original globals.css (#111320 bg, #8383e7 text) intact. Redesign is class-level only using existing palette pushed vivid.

nodes.label: Brand Accent Color Scheme
nodes.rationale: Brand violet #6f6fdc for gradients/borders/focus, bright accent #c084fc for labels and trending, with #8b8bff/#a78bfa highlights. Cards/panels use border #2a3570 (or /50 subtle), surface #141728/#12163a, page #111320.

nodes.label: Primary Button Style
nodes.rationale: Purple gradient from-[#6f6fdc] to-[#4b3bb0] with soft glow shadow. Shared components/ui/Button.jsx implements this. Active tabs reuse the gradient.

nodes.label: Raw SQL Only Convention
nodes.rationale: All DB writes use sequelize.query() with named replacements. Never introduce Sequelize model-level CRUD to maintain query clarity and control.

nodes.label: Soft Delete Convention
nodes.rationale: Always filter deleted_at IS NULL on queries against movie, show, person, person_aka, profile tables to preserve historical data.

nodes.label: JWT Bearer Token Authentication
nodes.rationale: Backend uses Supabase service-role key to verify JWT tokens. Frontend uses supabase.auth.getSession() and onAuthStateChange for state management.

nodes.label: dedupIngest Pattern
nodes.rationale: Always use dedupIngest(key, fn) from ingestionQueue.js when triggering background ingest from API routes to prevent concurrent duplicate ingestion of same entity.

nodes.label: Monorepo Structure
nodes.rationale: Co-located Express backend (root) and Vite React frontend (Frontend/) for tight integration and shared development workflows.
